title: Record of controlled substances held for immediate treatment or administration
rule_summary: Under 105 CMR 700.003(G)(9) the pharmacist MAINTAINS A RECORD of any controlled substance maintained for the purpose of dispensing for immediate treatment or administering pursuant to 105 CMR 700.000 and any related Department guidelines.
exam_relevance: Tests the record-keeping condition attached to controlled substance stock a collaborating pharmacist holds for immediate treatment or for administration, which sits beside the supply limits in 105 CMR 700.003(G)(5) and (G)(6).

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

common_confusions: The record covers stock maintained for dispensing for immediate treatment or for administering, which is a different record from the prescription itself.
verification_notes: Read in the current official publication of 105 CMR 700.000 at the Department of Public Health download link on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule rather than by changing an existing record, so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
